title: JWT-Secured FastAPI Service
goal: Build a FastAPI service with JWT auth and rate limiting
approach: Short-lived access + refresh tokens; auth middleware; per-IP rate limiter; tests cover token expiry, refresh, and 429 paths. Council passed on clear separation of auth vs business logic.

title: Cross-Reference Investigation
goal: Investigate vendor payments against lobbying disclosures
approach: OpenPlanter entity-resolution across both datasets, then cross-reference for shared directors/addresses; the red-team gates every inferred connection before it ships. Vetted for surfacing non-obvious links without overclaiming.

title: Regulated Hardware Architecture Decision
goal: Decide a compute substrate for a regulated medical edge workload
approach: Three independent lenses (silicon, physics, regulation) + a red-team that classifies each analog macro before any determinism claim. Vetted conclusion: for regulated edge inference, determinism dominates efficiency.
